raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice (ingest_ts 02:00 and 05:00, 668 rows vs about 340 normal). The copies are identical, and silver_transactions has no dedup, so the 317 POSTED txn_ids are double counted in silver and in every gold table. The fix dedupes by txn_id in silver, keeping the latest delivery.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
